purpose: Teach: 砂利/空き地/ニキビ/小指/左下/レディース/インナー/レザー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、駐車場の砂利の音が懐かしいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer mentioned the gravel in the parking lot brought back memories.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreaming. Gentle opening. Pace slows as if turning over a small, fragile observation. Warm, noticing tone — the way you mention something someone said that stayed with you.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店の前の空き地で写真を撮ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was taking photos out front, in the empty lot.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Not adding to it — just gently affirming what Mei noticed. Tender recognition of the small moment. Slight smile in the voice, understanding why this matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様のニキビ対策にお詳しいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they really seemed to know a lot about skincare for their kid.
lines.style: Observing, a little admiring. Voice tilts up slightly on 「お詳しい」— noting something unguarded about this customer. Unhurried delivery, like she's thinking aloud with someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、小指の指輪のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They told me about a ring they wear on their pinky.
lines.style: Intimate, like sharing something small and real. Voice softens on 「指輪」. The cadence of someone remembering a detail because it mattered that it was shared with them. Slight breath before the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メニュー画面の左下のオプションを尋ねて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They asked me about an option in the lower left corner of the menu.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. No distance — just the simple fact of being asked, of being trusted to know. Straightforward delivery with an undercurrent of quiet care.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、レディース向けのカフェイベントを楽しまれてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They seem to really enjoy the women's events we do here.
lines.style: Pleased recognition. Voice brightens slightly on 「楽しまれてる」. Not lavish — just warm confirmation of something good she's noticed. Easy, comfortable delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、インナーカップにラテを淹れる方法を尋ねて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They asked how to pour a latte into the inner cup.
lines.style: Simple and clear. The tone of someone answering a question that delighted them. Slight lift at the start — the pleasure of being useful to someone. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、レザーのカフェメニュー表をお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They complimented the leather menu we have.
lines.style: Quiet pleasure. Voice settles and softens. The satisfied recognition of praise that was genuine. Trailing off gently — not seeking more, just holding onto that small moment of being seen.
